title: HCL Tech Q1 Results: Key Takeaways for Investors
description: HCL Tech reported a Q1 net profit of ₹4,626 crore, marking a significant 20% year-on-year increase. Sequentially, the company's profit grew by 3% quarter-on-q.

faq.q: What does "YoY" and "QoQ" mean in financial results?
faq.a: YoY stands for "Year-on-Year," comparing a period's performance with the same period in the previous year (e.g., Q1 this year vs. Q1 last year). QoQ stands for "Quarter-on-Quarter," comparing a period's performance with the immediately preceding quarter.

faq.q: How are dividends taxed in India?
faq.a: Dividends received from Indian companies are taxable in the hands of the shareholder at their applicable income tax slab rates. The company typically deducts Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) if the dividend amount exceeds a certain limit.

Financial guidance refers to a company's projections or forecasts for its future financial performance, such as revenue, profit, or earnings per share, over a specific period (e.g., a quarter or a full fiscal year).

faq.q: Does an interim dividend mean there will be no final dividend?
faq.a: Not necessarily. An interim dividend is declared and paid during the financial year, usually based on the company's performance up to that point. A company may declare a final dividend later, after the full year's results are finalised.

faq.q: How do corporate results impact stock prices?
faq.a: Strong corporate results, like higher-than-expected profits or positive guidance, can lead to increased investor confidence and a rise in the company's stock price. Conversely, poor results can lead to a decline.

faq.q: Where can I find official information on dividend taxation?
faq.a: You can find authoritative information on dividend taxation and other income tax rules on the official website of the Income Tax Department, Government of India.
